titulo_fr: Lire une consigne de santé : Observer les formes
titulo_es: Read health indications: Vocabulary and forms
intro: It includes frequency, duration and precautions in a general health recommendation. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: It includes frequency, duration and precautions in a general health recommendation. It relates the matter to the request and checks the dates, conditions and actions that the message asks to perform.
Attention: « Depuis », « pendant » and « avant de » place duration and order; do not turn a general recommendation into a diagnosis. In this fragment, «notice» means «Package leaflet».

frases.fr: Le traitement dure cinq jours; il faut lire les précautions avant de commencer.
frases.es: El tratamiento dura cinco días; hay que leer las precauciones antes de empezar.
frases.en: The treatment lasts five days; the precautions must be read before starting.

frases.fr: Évitez de conduire si le médicament provoque de la somnolence.
frases.es: Evite conducir si el medicamento provoca somnolencia.
frases.en: Avoid driving if the medicine causes drowsiness.

frases.fr: La notice indique de prendre un comprimé après le repas, deux fois par jour.
frases.es: El prospecto indica tomar un comprimido después de la comida, dos veces al día.
frases.en: The package leaflet indicates taking one tablet after food, twice a day.
